kind: exploratory prospective causal language model / structural intervention
primary_question: Does a prospective lookahead edge-cut policy improve future language rule learning, not merely remove currently weak edges, under a shared physical Mirror supergraph?
scope: Finite 3-node 2-view graph, 18 ordered directed edge-MLP functions, 2 sequential recurrent passes; first stage optimizes only edge masks. NOT a full learned rewiring, nodes/loops/views/heads NAS, arbitrary MLP representability, or natural language result.

model.encoder: token and position embeddings plus causal 2-head attention
model.edge_decoder: signed permutation mixing of one globally shared 288-scalar core; Householder-tanh-Householder, direct tanh and affine controls
model.hard_gate: separate Boolean mask that prevents generation and execution of cut edge

synthetic_causal_language_data.sequence: BOS ASSIGN key_0 val_0 ASSIGN key_1 val_1 SEP FILL QUERY key_query value_of_key_query

training.objective: mean next-token cross entropy + 2* last query-token cross entropy

cut_policy.shortlist: four disjoint uniformly sampled edge pairs among currently active edges; deterministic given world,seed,event and active list
cut_policy.decision: choose candidate with lowest weighted dev loss after H matched training batches; separate conditional rule only cut if best score improves on keep by >=0.0005

hypotheses_and_pass.H_mechanism: hard-cut reduces actually executed edge MLPs from 18 to 12 for forced policies without future-token leakage; tests and forward-backward gradients pass
hypotheses_and_pass.H_learning: mirror_lookahead beats both mirror_random and mirror_low_gate by >=0.02 absolute fresh OOD query accuracy in >=4/6 paired world-seeds while no worse than 1.01x in fresh ID mean causal NLL (both paired controls); label exploratory not statistical proof
hypotheses_and_pass.H_mirror_specific: mirror_lookahead beats both affine_lookahead and direct_tanh_lookahead on fresh OOD query accuracy in >=4/6 with comparable actual bytes and inference latency; otherwise no Mirror-specific benefit
hypotheses_and_pass.H_guard: guarded intervention need not prune; report events accepted/rejected and comparison with forced and never-prune
hypotheses_and_pass.H_efficiency: report both training updates and probe updates and compare mirror_keep_extra with equal total optimizer-step compute; no free lookahead search

constraints: No source data or labels from fresh in optimization, policy or checkpoint selection
CPU-only measurements; hardware clock unspecified; median timing from 15 warmups and 75 timed steps
CUDA, natural language cross-entropy scaling, arbitrary graph rewiring, node/view/step pruning, learned rerouting, GPU fusion not evaluated
Numerical FLOPs/MAC claims are proxy and report non-MLP costs separately
Do not regard all generated logical weights as independently learnable
